mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 0.1% compresses discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy remains accommodative.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.1%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in the federal funds rate above 0.5% signals imminent monetary tightening, increasing equity discount rates and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and rise in payroll employment signals robust labor market conditions, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Joint movement of UNRATE falling and PAYEMS rising fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances, or interaction term coefficient is insignificant (p>0.05) over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 6.5%), a decline in unemployment rate signals improving labor conditions that increase consumer confidence and spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 6.5% and UNRATE declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong residential demand, correlating with broader economic expansion and corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of periods when HOUST is rising, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year CPI increase above 2.5% signals accelerating inflation, prompting central bank tightening and reducing real equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust manufacturing output, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is rising, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals broad-based consumer demand expansion, accelerating corporate revenue growth and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Joint increase in HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances, or interaction term coefficient is insignificant (p>0.05) over any 3-year window.
